global.criterion: Compact sculpted premium 3D educational cartoon miniature on warm off-white with plausible materials, low three-quarter scene, clean negative space; not photoreal, a broad landscape, overhead diagram or visible character.
No embedded words, numerals, arrows, fake text, product name, school/Spark identity, branding, logo or watermark.
No person, hand, active chemical release, rescue, eye/skin exposure, actual treatment, neutralization or danger plume shown as safe to enter.

s103-video-decide.criterion: A harmless small sealed practice tray and a clearly separate closed unfamiliar area are physically apart; there is no transfer or approach to the unknown area.
A visible open route withdraws from the observation position without passing through the unknown area or the practice tray; no arrow or person is drawn.
The small simulated practice patch does not visually authorize untrained cleanup, imply a universal safe volume or portray an unknown airborne hazard as safe to enter.
The image is a low close training-store diorama with bottle/tray/barrier, not the higher orthographic split-site reading map planned for this lesson.
